query:
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
'policies',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',schemaname,'table',tablename,'name',policyname,'roles',roles,'command',cmd,'permissive',permissive,'qual',qual,'check',with_check)) FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename IN('admins','orders','intercity_requests','riders','rider_kyc','users','rider_assignments')),
'table_security',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',relname,'rls',relrowsecurity,'force_rls',relforcerowsecurity,'acl',relacl::text)) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname IN('admins','orders','intercity_requests','riders','rider_kyc','users','rider_assignments')),
'functions',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'name',p.proname,'definition',pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'acl',proacl::text)) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE (n.nspname='public' AND p.proname IN('is_admin','check_is_order_candidate_rider')) OR(n.nspname='auth' AND p.proname IN('uid','email','role'))),
'indexes',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',tablename,'definition',indexdef)) FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename IN('admins','orders','intercity_requests','riders','rider_kyc','users','rider_assignments'))
) AS evidence

functions.name: uid
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.uid()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select 
  coalesce(
    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), ''),
    (nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub')
  )::uuid
$function$

functions.name: check_is_order_candidate_rider
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_is_order_candidate_rider(p_order_id uuid, p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.rider_assignments ra
        INNER JOIN public.riders r ON r.id = ra.rider_id
        WHERE ra.order_id = p_order_id AND r.user_id = p_user_id
    );
$function$

functions.name: is_admin
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.admins
    WHERE email = auth.email() AND is_active = true
  );
$function$
